title: $1,000 in AMD in 2016 is now worth this
caption:
In 2016, AMD was a struggling chipmaker.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:AMD:2016-01-04} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with AMD in 2016? 👇
sources: AMD price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 2016, AMD was a struggling chipmaker.
Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Watch what it turns into. Today, it would be worth about {growth:AMD:2016-01-04}.
Time in the market does the heavy lifting.
